botInfo:
Hello, I'm ThingRoller! I roll dice and tables and stuff. I am case-insensitive.
__Recognized Commands__:
formatExamples:
__Examples of Things I Can Calculate__:
  !3d6
  !roll d6
  !r 1d6
  !r 1d6 + 3
  !r advantage
  !r disadvantage + d4 + 3d8 - 8
  !r -4
  !r 5 * 3
  !r -3d6 / 4
  !r e 1d6
  !r -e 1d6
  !r 2d6, 3d8 + 5
  !r e 1d8 + 2, 1d6 + 2
  !r bonus
  !r penalty - 5
  !r double_bonus, double_penalty
formatNotes: Note: I don't recognize parentheses, and I evaluate left to right. I won't roll more than a million dice at a time.
diceExpressions:
__Valid Dice Expressions__:
  `#` - Numbers
  `+, -, *, x, /` - Mathematical operators. Both * and x indicate multiplication.
  `(X)d(y)` - Roll x dice of y sides and sum the results. Both x and y must be integers greater than 0.
  `advantage` - Roll two d20 and keep the highest
  `disadvantage` - Roll two d20 and keep the lowest
  bonus - Roll percentile with a bonus die.
  `doublebonus, double_bonus` - Roll percentile with two bonus dice.
  `penalty` - Roll percentile with a penalty die.
  `doublepenalty, double_penalty` - Roll percentile with two penalty dice.
  `e, -e` - Exploding dice. Must be at the beginning of the expression. If the highest number is rolled on an exploding die, the die is rolled again and the results are added. This will continue as long as the highest number keeps being rolled.
  `,` - Commas separate different expressions to be handled independently.
parsingFailure: I feel like I should calculate '{}', but can't parse it. Sorry.
nameParsingFailure: I was unable to parse the command {}. Please enter name generation in the format of !name [type] [gender].

recognizedCommands.!roll [dice expression]: - roll and calculate. See !expressions and !examples for more information.
recognizedCommands.!examples: - show examples of legal dice expressions
recognizedCommands.!name [type] [gender] <1-20>: - generate 1 name, or a user-specified number. I can generate names of the following types: American, angel (genderless), demon (genderless), dragon (genderless), dragonborn, dwarf, elf, european, gnome, halfling, lovecraft (American 1920s), and orc.
recognizedCommands.!quest <1-5>: - generate a random quest using the Tiny Dungeons method, or up to five at a time.
recognizedCommands.!kungfu <1-20>: - generate a random Kung Fu move name
recognizedCommands.!draw <1-52>: - draw a card from a standard 52-card deck. Deck reshuffles when it runs out.
recognizedCommands.!shuffle: - resuffle the deck (leaving jokers as they already were; in or out)
recognizedCommands.!nojokers: - resuffle the deck, leaving jokers out
